{{Top|leg}}
'''T-Star 2''' was a location in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], [[spinward]] of the tail end of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], past the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated that T-Star 2 was excluded from the ''Atlas'' and subsequent system appendixes due to it being a code name.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_4.jpg|author=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-10-22}}</ref>
